data.name: Aryant
data.gender_notes: Aryant is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word 'arya' meaning noble or honorable. In Hindu mythology, Aryant refers to a valiant and just king or warrior. The name Aryant carries the meaning “Noble, Honorable” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Aryant usually hope their child will grow to embody noble, honorable and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Aryant belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Noble, Honorable.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aryant total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Aryant" has a rich cultural significance in Indian history and mythology. Aryans were the earliest civilization known to inhabit the Indian subcontinent, and they are considered the foundational society that set the moral, ethical, linguistic, and cultural norms for a civilization that continues to thrive more than five millennia later. The name "Aryant" is a tribute to the noble and honorable Aryan heritage. The name represents bravery, morality, and wisdom, and is commonly given to boys in Indian communities as a source of pride and inspiration.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Aryant is a reminder of the divine qualities of nobility, honor, and purity. It is believed that by naming a child Aryant, the parents are seeking to instill in him or her the qualities of a noble soul. The name also carries the hope that the child will live a virtuous life and contribute positively to society. In Hinduism, the quest for the divine is an integral part of life, and the name Aryant embodies this quest by reminding us of the divine qualities that reside within each one of us.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The name Aryant is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Arya', meaning noble or virtuous. It is believed that a person with this name is endowed with noble qualities and is destined for greatness. The 'nt' at the end is said to represent the divine presence within, guiding and supporting the individual on their life journey.

historical_references.reference:
Aryan invaders, also known as the Aryans, were a group of Indo-European people who migrated into the Indian subcontinent around 1500 BCE from the steppes of Central Asia.
They brought with them the Indo-Aryan language, Hinduism, and a complex social and religious system based on the Vedas, which would later form the basis of the Indian caste system.
The Rigveda, the oldest known Hindu scripture, was composed during this time and records their early religious practices and mythology.
Aryant is a name mentioned several times in the Rigveda, but its meaning and significance are not clear.
historical_references.context: Migration of the Aryan people into the Indian subcontinent and the composition of the Rigveda

historical_references.reference:
Another reference to Aryant can be found in the Mahabharata, an epic poem composed between 400 BCE and 200 CE.
In this text, Aryant is mentioned as the name of one of the five sons of Arjuna and Draupadi.
According to the story, Arjuna and Draupadi had five sons, who were born to them by various goddesses.
Aryant, also known as Bhishma, was born to them by the goddess Ganga.
historical_references.context: Aryant as one of the five sons of Arjuna and Draupadi mentioned in the Mahabharata

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Aryant' has gained popularity in modern culture through various trends. In the cosplay community, individuals often adopt unique and meaningful names for their characters, with 'Aryant' being a popular choice due to its ancient and regal sound. In the gaming world, particularly in multiplayer online battle arena (MOBA) games, players may choose this name to reflect their strategic and strong-willed personas. Lastly, in the fitness community, individuals may adopt the name as a reminder of their personal journey towards physical and mental growth.
